goal: Measure whether repository context and history let an agent avoid duplicate work, detect stale issue state, and derive a high-value follow-up that a fresh issue-only workflow would miss.

observed_repo_dna.trait: Check issue comments and active PR references before starting, even when an issue is unassigned.
Small focused fixes with targeted regression tests are preferred over broad changes.
An open issue is not sufficient evidence that work remains; current source must be checked.
main/v2 and v1.x frequently require separate implementations or backports.

derived_candidate.title: Removed registration handles can be resurrected by update() after remove()
derived_candidate.origin: Explicit out-of-scope note in PR #2724, then verified against current registry-handle implementation and searched for existing tracking.
derived_candidate.credit: PR #2724 author @YatsukBogdan1 identified the pre-existing tool-path behavior; this trial treats that note as evidence, not as a novel discovery by Hunch.
derived_candidate.expected_invariant: remove() is terminal for the registration represented by the handle; later mutations must not reinsert it or emit misleading list_changed signals.

benchmark.note: This first run establishes the repository-screening and currentness baseline. Code-edit metrics start once a writable fork is available.
